environment that is used by living things 
including humans is called a natural resource. 
Natural resources include air, water, soil, 
minerals, fossil fuels, plants, wild life etc. Many 
natural resources are used as raw materials. They 
play a vital role in the economic development of 
any region. Natural resources are classified on 
several basis. Based on continued availability, 
the resources are categorised into two types, 
they are renewable and non-renewable. 
Renewable resources are those which have 
natural regeneration after their utilisation.

Cuddapah and Anantapur districts in Andhra 
Pradesh and Salem, Namakkal, Tiruvannamalai, 
Tiruchirappalli, Coimbatore, Madurai and 
Tirunelveli districts in Tamil Nadu are notable 
for the production of iron ore.
